body_text: Children’s learning shows up in many ways: a conversation, a drawing, a construction, a question or a new attempt. We don’t just record what children did; we try to understand the thinking behind it.

items.title: Observe
items.text: Teachers notice what children are interested in, what they know and how they are thinking.

items.title: Document
items.text: Photographs, children’s words, work samples, learning stories and teacher reflections.

image.alt: Educator listening closely to a young girl

items_2.title: Respond
items_2.text: Documentation helps teachers plan experiences that follow children’s interests and needs.

items_2.title: Revisit
items_2.text: Children look back at their learning, revisit ideas and see how their thinking has grown.
